source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: Vitamin D deficiency is associated with the number of neurofibromas in NF1.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 70 Lammert 2006 PMID 16571643. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Claim wording follows the title of ref 70 (verified in PubMed). The guideline states the effect of vitamin D supplementation on bone density and fractures in NF1 is unclear.
